name: @pipeup/github
description: Offers to tell people on GitHub when a comment mentions them: opens a new issue on the author's repository with their @name in it.
author: Pipeup contributors

network.says: Only when you press Mention on GitHub: your browser opens GitHub's new-issue page with the person's @name, your name, the comment's words and this page's title and address filled in, so GitHub receives them as the page opens; nothing is filed until you submit it there.

asks.what: the repository the issues go to (owner/repo)
